title_en: The Paramount+ November Streaming Lineup Includes a Robin Williams Masterpiece and Thanksgiving Football
body_en:
With the final episodes of Avatar: Seven Havens out now, you may be wondering what else you'll be able to get out of your Paramount+ subscription this month. Paramount+ might not have many Originals , but you can still look forward to a solid lineup of movies and quite a bit of NFL football this November.
The biggest new show being added this month is Yellowjackets Season 4, which premieres on November 20. It's still a Showtime Original, so you'll need a Premium subscription if you want to catch new episodes as soon as they're available.
If you're wondering what's worth watching, we've gathered together some of our top picks right here. You can also jump to all of the new releases for November for the full list by day.
If you were born in the late '80s or early '90s, Hook is likely embedded within you as a core memory. Although it wasn't critically acclaimed at the time, it's a beloved childhood adventure movie with an absolutely stacked cast. Robin Williams plays an adult Peter Pan, Dustin Hoffman plays Captain Hook, and Julia Roberts is Tinker Bell. If you're looking for a movie to rewatch over the weekend this November, this is an excellent option.
In addition to being added to Paramount+, Hook is also getting a 4K Blu-ray steelbook on November 17.
Before Samuel L. Jackson was putting together the Avengers in his role as Nick Fury, he was leading an entirely different kind of team. Coach Carter is one of the best basketball movies ever made and one of Jackson's best roles overall. Based on a true story, the film is centered around Ken Carter, the head basketball coach at Richmond High. If you like sports dramas and are looking for a heartwarming story, this is a must-watch.
For those with Paramount+ Premium, the popular Showtime Original series Yellowjackets will be making it's return with Season 4 this month. The first episode drops on November 20, followed by weekly releases of new episodes every Friday. Here's the official description for the new season:
“As the survivors race to bury their sins before rescue arrives and an old flame roars back into town with plans of her own, turns out not every homecoming is a joyous one, and this one’s going to sting.”
Paramount+ is one of the best places to stream the NFL , but this year it's the only place to stream Thanksgiving football. If you want to watch the Chicago Bears take on the Detroit Lions while you chow down on some turkey, it will be here this year. Of course you can also just watch it on CBS if you already have a TV antenna .
Note : This list is subject to change in November pending additional announcements from Paramount+ . Click on any of the links provided to see IGN's review.
If you don't already have a Paramount+ subscription , you may want to wait a little bit longer for a deal. Although the streaming service hasn't yet announced a Black Friday sale, they almost always offer one of the best deals of the year in November.
Last year, Paramount+ offered the first two months of the service for $2.99 per month for new and returning subscribers. If this deal comes back in 2026, you can expect it to arrive on actual Black Friday and last through Cyber Monday .
Jacob Kienlen is a Senior Audience Development Strategist and Writer for IGN. Born and raised in Portland, Oregon, he has considered the Northwest his home for his entire life. With a bachelor's degree in communication and 10 years of professional writing experience, his expertise is spread across a variety of different pop culture topics — from TV series to books and the latest LEGO sets .
